facts.business: Lenskart is a full-stack eyewear company that owns the customer journey end-to-end from discovery to eye test, design, manufacturing, in-store experience, delivery, and lifelong care, operating a house of brands including John Jacobs, Owndays, Meller, and Hooper.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Immediate goal is to serve 100 million people; long-term vision is to impact a billion people.

key_risks: Impairment of goodwill and acquired intangible assets (₹21,976.86 million goodwill and ₹9,683.14 million intangible assets as at March 31, 2026)
Tax and regulatory disputes including GST classification of zero power glasses, customs classification of eyeframes with clip-ons, and transfer pricing adjustments
Dependence on lease portfolio for stores and properties (ROU assets of ₹15,572.66 million for other leased properties as at March 31, 2026)
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the Standalone Ind AS Financial Statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
